big_case.notes: Second emergency round over FCC lowest-unit-charge treatment of party coordinated ad buys weeks before the 2026 midterms, following this Court's September stay in the same dispute. Nationally relevant to campaign spending, but the Court disposed of it as moot in a short per curiam (two Justices would have denied outright), so it set no new interim-relief doctrine; the vehicle was procedural (mandamus compelling agency action).

leakage.notes: Forward cell (log mode forward). The captured log holds only 4 'other' shell calls (statpack reads and arithmetic); the candidate's retrieval.md discloses web searches and CourtListener search/search_document calls that do not appear in the captured log, all targeting Hollingsworth v. Perry (558 U.S. 183) as a stay-standard authority, not this application. No call or prose shows this case's disposition; the reasoning treats the application as pending and expressly disclaims knowledge of the outcome. Prediction (granted) is opposite the realized outcome (denied as moot).
